title: AetherOS Telemetry Plane — Overview
description: Deterministic 7-layer plane dashboard: SEB ring health (Layer 1), trace entry point (Layer 4), log volume (Layer 5), integrity alerts (Layer 6). Static panels only; no external template variables.

panels.title: SEB ring depth (bytes in ring)
panels.description: Layer 1: bytes currently held in each SEB ring, exported by aether-collect via OTLP. 65536 = full; sustained growth means the consumer is behind.

panels.title: SEB dropped events (total)
panels.description: Layer 1 overflow counter. Must be 0 in steady state; >0 means producers outran aether-collect or a ring is orphaned. Thresholds: green=0, red>0.

panels.title: Trace search (Jaeger, Layer 4)
panels.description: Entry point into distributed traces ingested by Jaeger all-in-one (OTLP gRPC :14317, UI :16686).

options.content: [Open Jaeger trace search](http://localhost:16686/search) — select a service emitted by an aetherProbe-instrumented process, then search. Traces reach Jaeger via otelcol's `otlp/jaeger` exporter.

panels.title: Log volume by level
panels.description: Layer 5: SEB_LOG-derived entries in Loki, bucketed by level (DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR/FATAL as emitted by aether_log levels 1-5).

panels.title: Integrity alerts (last 1h)
panels.description: Layer 6: SEB_ALERT events from the integrity bridge (Wazuh FIM/rootcheck + osquery hash/port checks), counted over the dashboard window. Thresholds: green=0, yellow=1, red=5.
